integrity: Exact algebraic identities are proved in RESULT.md and the specialized rational arithmetic and algebraic root approximation are reproduced by verify.py. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the printed coefficient-one autonomous ODE at the stated parameter slice. It does not determine basins for the nonzero equilibria, exclude coexisting invariant sets, or establish nonlinear Hopf criticality at the spectral crossing. Full text of the 2015 model source was not recovered during this review.
title: Exact stability skeleton of the coefficient-one normalized PMSG flow
